parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing criminalisation, bathroom/facility ban, border-screening practice or police targeting is documented, and identity-based prison placement is the stated national rule. Gender identity/expression have been federally protected since 2017, hate motivation is in the criminal code, and provincial human-rights complaints have a documented policy/case-law route — climate and recourse positives, not resident LGR as a direct visitor protection. Offsetting friction: police-reported hate crimes rose sharply but are not disaggregated by gender identity, the 39% violence survey is LGBT-wide over 5 years (mostly verbal, 2022), an organised anti-trans movement and two provinces' school/health rollbacks using override clauses signal political hostility for residents, and a 2022 report alleged abuse of gender-diverse prisoners despite the placement rule. This is reduced risk with uneven, deteriorating social/political conditions, below the strongest 0.85 examples.
